room_or_space: Front detail (caption FRONT DETAIL): a pointed, V-plan window bay at the front of the building, shown as a horizontal section/plan detail and a matching exterior elevation; no room name is given on the sheet

proportions.notable_proportion: No figured dimensions or scale; as drawn, the two angled faces of the bay meet at approximately a right angle and the bay projects (corner-wall line to apex) roughly 0.7 of its width across the side returns; in elevation the eave band is roughly twice as wide as the wall height beneath it, and each window is a tall narrow vertical of roughly 1:5 to 1:6 (width:height)

layout.organisation: Bilaterally symmetrical pointed bay. In plan, two parallel side-return walls (each with a window between an end pier and a corner pier) turn inward through short solid masonry walls to chamfered piers; from each chamfered pier a short glazed re-entrant segment leads to a second chamfered pier, and from there a long glazed angled face runs to a narrow pointed apex pier where the two faces meet. Thin lines inside the V trace the eave/soffit outline above. The elevation shows the same bay as a low hipped-roofed volume: wide masonry end piers, four tall windows in two pairs about a central pier, a projecting sill course and a coursed masonry base.
layout.axes: One axis of bilateral symmetry through the apex of the V in plan and through the ridge point of the hipped roof in elevation; no other axes or grid lines are drawn
layout.entry_sequence: Not shown; no door or entry appears on the sheet
layout.circulation: Not shown; the sheet is a wall-and-window detail with no floor, furniture or circulation information

openings.position: Plan: one long window in each of the two angled faces of the V, running from the chamfered pier to the apex pier, with an intermediate mullion block near mid-length
openings.pattern: Continuous glazed band on both angled faces, meeting at the pointed apex; glass drawn as a thin double line with small frame blocks at each end and at the mullion

openings.position: Plan: one window in each parallel side-return wall, between the hatched end pier at the top of the drawing and the hatched corner pier
openings.pattern: Single sash in a stippled wall thickness, frame blocks at head and foot of the opening in plan

openings.position: Plan: one short window on each side in the re-entrant segment between the corner chamfered pier and the second chamfered pier at the start of the angled face
openings.pattern: Short single sash set behind a stepped stippled pier mass; mirrors on both sides of the axis

openings.position: Elevation: four tall narrow windows between the two wide hatched end piers, arranged as two pairs separated by a central plain pier, each pair flanked by narrow plain jambs
openings.pattern: Tall narrow vertical lights with a double frame line and a single vertical sash/muntin line near one edge of each light; all four share a common head under the eave band and a common sill course
